name: Palladous-Barrow
description: A battered sphere of bare stone, cratered so densely that old impacts overlap like raindrops on a pond. Through it all runs impact-scarred wastelands, stark under a black sky.
Vacuum carries no sound at all; the loudest thing on this world is your own pulse inside the suit.
Nothing about the gravity well anomaly appears on any natural-phenomena registry. The leading research institutions classify it as 'pending,' which is science's word for afraid.
Opportunity here wears armor. Claims on silicon, uranium, aluminum and platinum are staked, defended, and occasionally avenged, and the nearest law is a week's burn away.
